title: It is Not Yet Another Tool: Creating and Deploying an Agentic AI Companion in a Security Operations Center
abstract: arXiv:2609.06250v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Security Operations Centers (SOCs) process large amounts of tickets, most of which are low-interest events not worthy of further investigation. The repetitive nature of this task and similarity of the vast amounts of tickets make it a prime candidate for generative AI-based automation. We created and deployed an agentic AI companion utilizing large language models through fieldwork within a SOC for over one year. The design of the SOC AI companion was driven by researchers' participation and interactions within the SOC's daily work. SOC analysts were invited to use it during the last four months of the fieldwork. We analyzed the analysts' usage of the companion and found that in more than 90% of the cases the companion's outputs were reused by analysts in the ticket's closing report. translated_title: 它不仅仅又是一个工具：在安全运营中心创建和部署智能体AI助手
translated_abstract: 安全运营中心（SOC）需要处理大量的工单，其中大部分是无需进一步调查的低关注度事件。这项任务的重复性以及海量工单之间的相似性，使其成为基于生成式AI自动化的理想候选场景。我们在一个安全运营中心内通过为期一年多的实地研究，创建并部署了一个基于大语言模型的智能体AI助手。该SOC AI助手的设计源于研究人员亲身参与SOC的日常工作并与分析师进行互动。在实地研究的最后四个月中，SOC分析师受邀使用该助手。我们分析了分析师对该助手的使用情况，发现在超过90%的案例中，分析师在工单的结案报告中重复使用了该助手生成的输出内容。我们的研究结果表明，当与预期用户“在一线战壕里”共同设计时，SOC AI助手可以超越“又是一个工具”的定位，而是真正融入安全运营工作流程的系统级助手。
tldr: 通过在安全运营中心实地部署基于大语言模型的智能体AI助手一年多，研究发现超过90%的案例中分析师在工单结案报告中重复使用了AI助手的输出，证明与用户在一线深度协同设计的AI助手能够真正融入SOC的日常工作流程。
en_tdlr: Through over a year of fieldwork deploying an agentic AI companion powered by large language models in a Security Operations Center, analysts reused the companion's outputs in more than 90% of ticket closing reports, demonstrating that an AI companion designed "in the trenches" with its intended users can go beyond being just another tool.
